description: This file defines the SaveHolidayController class responsible for handling the pre-render logic for holiday creation/editing in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It sets up Vue components and properties based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveHolidayController
classes.description: Controller class that manages the preparation of Vue components for saving or editing holidays.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares Vue component with necessary properties before rendering, based on whether a holiday ID exists in the request.
